name: apply_patch
summary: apply_patch is a built-in tool in OpenAI's API that lets a model create, update and delete files by emitting structured diffs in the V4A format. The model returns apply_patch_call items, the developer's harness applies them and reports success or failure back, so the model can iterate. It is aimed at coding agents that edit codebases.
goodFor: Multi-file code edits from a coding agent
Small, reviewable diffs instead of full-file rewrites
watchOut: Your harness must parse V4A and apply patches itself
Validate paths to avoid directory traversal
Supported only on listed OpenAI models
